seed_selection: Ascending numeric order of the five historical confirmation seeds; first two, independent of outcomes and gain
metadata_source: experiments/e0_4g_baseline/canonical_4g.csv read with exact X-only usecols and dtype=str; previous label-free snapshot for role IDs
holdout_eligibility: IDs acquired after L333 and present in the current L_t; exclude every molecular-plus-five-recorded-conditions group also present in L333; additionally exclude entire same-recorded-condition groups represented in validation
pair_rule: Same canonical molecule, exactly one of the five recorded condition fields differs. PE/EA is compared by exact rational ratio; continuous values by Decimal strings; no rounded matching.
group_rule: Connected components of strict-single-factor edges plus same-recorded-condition identity edges among eligible rows. All component endpoints and all identical-condition rows are held out together. Components are never split.
volume_role: Primary mechanism subgroup. Other single-factor axes provide valid control groups and can fill the ten-component H.
selection: Take exactly ten components if qualified. Priority components containing a sample-volume-only pair, then stable sha256 of sorted component row IDs; do not use labels, residuals, predictions or validation gain. If ten components are not possible or volume minima fail, skip state without reducing criteria.
holdout_truth_usage: After model protocol freeze, used only for final held-out pair error; never for checkpoint selection or changing the model.
target_scaling: Reuse frozen original L333 target scales. H excludes L333 and same-condition groups shared with L333.
fit_limit: At most four eligible states times two model arms times two paired training seeds = sixteen successful fits. No training before root approval and C gate.
amendment: Root X-only review found one v1 H row in 157/L1005 and one in 887/L525 share full recorded conditions with validation. V2 excludes these keys before graph construction, retains all thresholds/model/seed/order rules. Authorized observed values had been parsed only to verify ID availability; none used for H or amendment.
